note: Range Slider provides a range_slider form element (extends core Range), a field widget id 'range_slider' for core integer/decimal/float fields, and a Webform element. Widget settings (schema field.widget.settings.range_slider) are orientation (horizontal|vertical) and output (_none_|below|above|left|right), stored on the entity_form_display component. No permissions, no Drush, no configure route. Medium creates an integer field on Article with the range_slider widget (orientation=vertical, output=above) and reads it back; hard switches an existing integer field's form-display component to the range_slider widget, verified against live config. All fixture fields are namespaced field_rs_*.

evals.prompt: The Drupal Range Slider module adds a field widget. On which core field types can the range_slider widget be used, and what is the widget's plugin id?
evals.expected_output: The widget plugin id is range_slider and it can be used on core numeric fields: integer, decimal, and float.

evals.prompt: What two settings does the Range Slider field widget expose, and what values can each take?
evals.expected_output: orientation (horizontal or vertical) and output (none / _none_, below, above, left, or right). They are stored under field.widget.settings.range_slider on the form-display component.

evals.prompt: How do I render a Range Slider directly in a custom Drupal form or render array (not via a field), and how do I show the current value with a unit suffix?
evals.expected_output: Use a render element with '#type' => 'range_slider' (class Element\RangeSlider extends core Range), set #min/#max, and set #output to below/above/left/right plus #output__field_prefix / #output__field_suffix (e.g. '$' … 'USD') to print the live value with units.

evals.prompt: On this site, the Article content type has a number field whose form widget is the Range Slider. Inspect the live default form display and give the machine name of that field and its Range Slider orientation setting.
evals.expected_output: The field is field_rs_known; in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default its component uses type range_slider with settings.orientation = vertical (and settings.output = above).

evals.prompt: On this site the Article content type has an integer field field_rs_task that currently uses the plain number widget. Switch its widget on the default form display to the Range Slider widget and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_rs_task component has type = range_slider (e.g. setComponent('field_rs_task', ['type' => 'range_slider', 'region' => 'content', 'settings' => [...]])->save()).
